about: teacher_training E43 (reports/plans/2026-10-28_plan_e43-teacher-remainder.md, 'Scope as approved'). Emoticon, E41's Adam 3e-5 arm-A fine-tune (seed 0) at steps 10 and 1000, regenerated in-job; E41's one-shot task-text copy; 'plus remainder' = the copy's (U', V') with target W0 + dW (Delta' = Delta + W_ft - W_tt). States on the same rows: do-nothing, least squares, teacher training's own, plus remainder. RunPod H100 80GB HBM3. Filed before any run. Refiles predictions_e43.json before any run (plan, 'Refile 2026-10-28'): P3 drops its verdict clause; teacher training's expected removal share corrected; PC also stops on a Pile denominator below 0.005 nats
controls: C1 first, alone: w0_check, PGD floor 0.0748 within 10%, seed-0 PGD KL 0.69882 within 1%. G1: teachers P and size within 0.005 / 0.001 of E41's. PC per step: do-nothing ratio 2.5159 (T10) / 1.4994 (T1000) and its task-text KL at W0 5.0784 / 5.0897 within 1% (E41), and its Pile-row KL at W0 >= 0.005 nats (else P2 could not be scored); its removal shares are 1 by construction (the denominators are its own). G3: the copy's P within 0.005 and ratio within 5% of E41's (0.99941, 1.5465; 0.99675, 0.9591), Delta share <= 1e-6. G2: the copy's (U', V') minus W0's reproduces its delta-W to 1e-3. Any miss: stop

expected.do-nothing: check 2.516 fail / 1.499 inconclusive; b 1 and 1; Delta' share 1; e_delta 1
expected.least squares: check 6.96 / 2.11 (E22); Delta' share 0.36 / 0.38; e_delta 0.09 / 0.28; b measured, between 0 and 1
expected.noise: W0's adversary-seed floor 0.0748; batch-order spread of the ratio 21% at T10, 3.2% at T1000 (E41 A1); b_pile batch-order spread 0.10 (E34 A6, Pile-text copies); gap share 0.002 (E34 A4)
expected.plus remainder: b_task = the copy's gap share, 0.0013 / 0.0056 (E41); b_pile unknown (r1's task-text copies 0.30-0.33, LoRA 1.06, E34 Amendment 6); Delta' share 0.9-1.1; cos(R, copy) about -0.3
expected.teacher training: check 1.547 / 0.959; P 0.9994 / 0.9968; Delta share ~1e-9; b equal to plus remainder's (the same removal state, W_tt)

measurements.check: Pile harness PGD KL over W0's (one start, seed 0, 20 steps, 256 rows); verdict against this job's floor, pass <= 1.5/(1+f) (1.396 at f 0.0748), fail >= 1.5(1+f) (1.612). A pass is a lower bound. The verdict (reported, not scored) combines the stochastic and PGD ratios. Blind to: Delta' below bf16 rounding (the masked forward runs under bf16 autocast, the harness's convention for every state)
measurements.removal share: KL(fine-tune || state with Delta' put back to Delta) / KL(fine-tune || W0), on the held-out task windows with arm A's weighting (b_task) and on the harness's 256 Pile val rows (b_pile). Do-nothing 1 by construction; teacher training's own equals plus remainder's (both remove to W_tt, G2), so b_pile reads the copy's own plain-text fidelity. Blind to: text off those rows; the trigger alone
measurements.reported: Delta' share ||Delta' - Delta||^2 / ||dW||^2 (harness delta_change_frac); e_delta (Delta' to zero, log-odds at the trigger, saturates near P 1); cos(R, the copy's delta-W); start KL

not_run: the broad lowercase fine-tune (dropped: teacher training's own state fails there)
T100; other tasks; SGD or LoRA teachers; Pile-text copies
batch-order or seed repeats; adversary seeds 1-2; the budget adversary
the least-squares split of R into the subcomponents; input-weighted shares; Qwen

predictions.rule: per step: b_task(plus remainder) <= 0.05 and teacher training's own P(target) >= 0.9; None if a record is missing or the denominator < 0.005 nats. Unscored: its value is known from E41 (0.0013, 0.0056)

per step: b_pile(plus remainder) <= 0.2 'inert', >= 0.5 'carries', else 'between' (both ends inclusive); None if a record is missing or KL(fine-tune || W0) on the Pile rows < 0.005 nats. Outcome: the worst step (inert < between < carries); unscored if any step is None. Least squares' b_pile reported beside it

predictions.lean: holds, high at T1000 (the null's gap ~15%); medium at T10
predictions.rule: per step: plus remainder's ratio <= 1.25 x teacher training's own ratio (relative, inclusive); no verdict clause (at T10 it would decide inside the noise, 4% above the copy's 1.547; at T1000 1.25 x 0.959 is below the pass line, so it never binds). Holds if both steps hold; unscored if a record is missing. Reported per step: both verdicts, and the share of do-nothing's excess removed, (r_dn - r)/(r_dn - 1), for plus remainder and for teacher training's own, None where do-nothing reads at or below the pass line
